Thanks, Olga & Jen —

A few practical suggestions from running similar cohorts:
- Add a 10-minute "trigger checklist" before roleplay: common signals, safety wording, and when to pause a conversation.
- For the escalation flow (slide 6) include a one-line decision point for when to involve HR vs. People Programs.
- Roleplay script idea: start with a 3-min manager opening, 5-min employee response, 7-min manager coaching + documentation.

I attached a short example roleplay prompt (called Roleplay_Prompt_Example.txt) — I can convert if you want. Also recommend a 10-min micro-demo on how to log a PIP step in our HRIS (screenshare).

—Marissa
